newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE oil refiner starts lube exports - paper.
newsitem.headline: UAE oil refiner starts lube exports - paper.

text.p: Western Oil Company, a part of India's Gadgil Western Group, has started exporting lube base oil to the Indian subcontinent from its fuel processing plant in Dubai, the UAE daily Khaleej Times reported on Monday.
Nandan Gadgil, chairman of Gadgil Western Group, told the newspaper that the plant at the Jebel Ali free zone in Dubai was operating at 80 percent of its 50,000 tonnes a year capacity.
The small upgrading plant previously used fuel oil as a feedstock but switched to waste lube oil this summer to comply with new local environmental regulations.
Marketing of the lubes would be focused on India's west coast and the company aims to set up similar plants in Bahrain and Singapore, Gadgil said.
The 48 million UAE dirham ($13 million) Jebel Ali plant went onstream in May 1995.
